x-note: v2.2 increment 3: the same module addition as any evolution, plus the opt-in three-way merge of two integration points. On the committed snapshot (no manual change) the authorisation is inert and the files are regenerated as usual; on a copy where main.py was edited by hand, `plan --allow-merge` merges the developer's hunks with the generator's and shows the three digests, the hunks and the diff; without `--allow-merge` the plan blocks (merge_not_authorized_on_command_line). The audit configuration is not changed by this evolution, so manual keys in it are simply preserved.
